stemMd: Which set of points is described by y > 2x − 1?

options.label: B
options.textMd: The open half-plane above the line y = 2x − 1

options.label: C
options.textMd: The line itself including all boundary points

options.label: E
options.textMd: The open half-plane below the line

explanationMd: For each x, the condition requires a y coordinate larger than the line’s value 2x − 1. This is the region above the line. Because the inequality is strict, boundary points are not included.

distractorRationale.c: The strict inequality excludes the line.
distractorRationale.e: The greater-than sign selects larger y values.
distractorRationale.d: The condition can hold for positive or negative x.
distractorRationale.a: That point lies on the excluded boundary.
